Scope: All requested guidance windows and three rubrics; all six whole lesson bodies (frozen EN, original RU and corrected RU for 妻/夫); whole JMdict 1496520 entry; exact amendment diffs/finding and continuity record. Every window returned complete with exit code 0; none unread.
F001 RESOLVED: Both kanji/妻.md and kanji/夫.md now say «слово несколько формальное» instead of «слово несколько официальное». JMdict 1496520 glosses 夫妻 as “husband and wife; married couple” and marks it “somewhat formal; not used for one's own family”; the correction removes the false implication of official status without changing that usage limit.
C1 CLEAN: Japanese spelling/reading, gloss and register statement remain supported by the complete JMdict entry; the amendment changes no Japanese text or facts.
C2 CLEAN: The only lesson-text edits are the authorized one-word substitutions in kanji/妻.md and kanji/夫.md, plus the accompanying manifest. The second-file correction is appropriate because its identical sentence cites the same entry and defect. Continuity confirms metadata unchanged; no direction, navigation or other content changes are implicated.
C3 CLEAN: «Несколько формальное» conveys “somewhat formal” clearly enough for a Russian beginner and no longer suggests governmental/official use; the own-family qualification remains intact. No new defect found.
Findings: none
Limits: No public dictionary pages consulted; relied on the complete supplied JMdict capture and bounded comparison. This is only the requested F001 follow-up, not a fresh review of the batch, quiz directions, or other content.
